purpose: Mechanism sanity-check for boundary overhead; not a benchmark of the FRANK target host.
interpretation: Serialization, loopback HTTP and per-event durable commits can add orders of magnitude more overhead than a tiny in-process dispatch path in this Python sandbox. The magnitude is environment-specific; only the direction motivates target-host A/B measurement and batching/zero-copy hypotheses.
next_test: Repeat with instrumented Project-Frankenstein current runtime on the actual target machine, including Core->Router no-op/stub path, real memory fan-out, GWS slow-subscriber lesion and SQLite writer contention.
